record.question: Can a prospectively frozen bounded set of delta-neutral BTC/ETH/SOL carry structures produce robust positive net economic value after complete two-leg implementation costs, carry/roll/borrow/collateral accounting, directional-beta control, venue stress, concentration and capacity constraints, without using 0072 observed results to select structures or thresholds?
record.hypothesis: At least one of the three roadmap-declared delta-neutral structure families can deliver positive net and stressed carry economics with residual directional beta inside a prospectively frozen tolerance and all preregistered implementation, robustness, concentration and capacity gates satisfied.
record.economic_mechanism: Delta-neutral crypto carry can arise from perpetual funding, spot-futures basis convergence and dated-future convergence when a cash or spot leg is hedged by an offsetting derivative leg. Realizable economics depend on complete hedge accounting including funding, basis convergence, roll, borrow, collateral yield or cost, fees, spreads, slippage, margin reserve, liquidation distance, custody and transfer frictions where cross-venue structures are used. The strategy must remain economically hedge-like rather than a disguised directional position.
record.stopping_rule: Traverse exactly the ten program lifecycle stages in order. Stage 1 OWNER-FIRST and Stage 2 DESIGN must use zero 0073 controlled scientific/history reads. DESIGN and PREREGISTRATION must prospectively freeze exact venue and instrument identities, point-in-time semantics, hedge construction, holding/rebalance/roll horizons, residual-beta tolerance, all C1/C2 cost assumptions, margin/liquidation rules, candidate definitions, robustness and stress tests, trial accounting, bootstrap/DSR/PBO rules where supported, concentration/capacity gates and terminal classifications before controlled history. NONHISTORICAL QUALIFICATION must pass with attempt 0/1 and zero controlled reads. After a separately merged CONTROLLED EXECUTION BOUNDARY, ZERO-RESULT PREFLIGHT must pass. Stage 8 requires contemporaneous explicit user authorization after preflight PASS, durable RUN_ATTEMPT.marker persistence before the first controlled content read, and exactly one controlled development-history attempt. Once consumed, no same-ID rerun, retune, rescue, candidate addition, venue substitution, history extension or threshold relaxation is allowed.
record.success_criteria: PASS only if valid exactly-once execution shows at least one prospectively frozen candidate passes all preregistered net and stressed economic, complete-cost, residual-beta, margin/liquidation, robustness, concentration, capacity and statistical gates. Any representative candidate must be selected only by the frozen preregistered rule. PASS grants research evidence only and does not grant production, signing or order authority.
record.failure_criteria: FAIL if valid execution completes but no prospectively frozen candidate passes all required economic and robustness gates. INCONCLUSIVE is limited to prospectively defined insufficient support or mathematically undefined inference conditions. INVALID_EXECUTION applies to identity/hash/read-count/lookahead/accounting/candidate-count/source/persistence or exactly-once drift. No same-ID rescue is permitted after result exposure or attempt consumption.
record.allowed_followup: Before attempt consumption, only semantics-preserving implementation or synthetic-qualification corrections that do not alter the merged DESIGN/PREREGISTRATION scientific contract. After immutable 0073 closeout, any altered structure family, venue universe, hedge rule, holding horizon, cost model, beta tolerance, stress suite, concentration/capacity gate or strategy translation requires a new research ID where governance requires it.
record.forbidden_followup: No candidate, threshold, venue, instrument, horizon, hedge ratio, cost assumption or stress selection using 0072 observed H01-H06 effects, p-values, support failure or any later 0073 result. No post-result threshold relaxation, family substitution, history extension, cost omission, stress deletion, unbounded leverage, unhedged directional beta, same-ID rerun, retune, rescue or recomputation. No production, signing or order-submission authority may be inferred from any 0073 outcome.
researcher_decisions: Freeze the OWNER-FIRST structural candidate-family ceiling to exactly the three delta-neutral carry structures already enumerated by the pre-existing roadmap: long spot/short perpetual, long spot/short dated future, and a cross-venue hedge only if custody, transfer and friction modeling is prospectively qualified.

Use the initial universe exactly as BTC, ETH and SOL; exact venues, instruments and eligibility rules must be prospectively frozen later in DESIGN and PREREGISTRATION before any 0073 controlled-history read.

Treat each candidate as complete hedge economics rather than independent long and short legs, with gross carry, funding, basis convergence, roll, borrow, collateral yield or cost, fees, spreads, slippage, margin reserve and liquidation distance accounted in temporal order.
Require at least the roadmap C1 realistic and C2 stressed cost regimes; exact numerical costs and break-even definitions must be frozen before controlled history.
Require a prospectively frozen hard residual directional-beta tolerance and prohibit any candidate that violates it from being described as delta-neutral.

Require venue closure or withdrawal impairment, funding and basis shock, spread and slippage widening, borrow or collateral deterioration and margin stress scenarios, plus concentration and capacity analysis.
Freeze bootstrap or lower-confidence-bound inference, DSR trial accounting and PBO where mathematically supported before controlled history; no post-result trial-count reduction is allowed.

Treat 0072 immutable INCONCLUSIVE as launch eligibility only under merged governance amendment 5b8153476aa63eb0c30d870a73e3bf14b4239ac8; it is not PASS and supplies zero scientific evidence or parameter-selection credit to 0073.
Preserve exactly one irreversible 0073 controlled development-history attempt with durable attempt marker before every permitted controlled content read.
Require contemporaneous explicit user authorization after Stage 7 preflight PASS and before Stage 8 irreversible execution.
Maintain production_authorized=false, signature_authorized=false and order_submission_authorized=false throughout 0073.
record.production_relevance: Research-only delta-neutral carry strategy evaluation. Any PASS may inform a later separately governed portfolio-integration decision only after immutable closeout; no automatic production, signature or order authority.
